title: Lunar laser reflectors

tellings.quote: "Ah, you know, we can see the the laser. We can put a laser on some of the things that we left on the surface of the moon."

plain: Equipment left on the Moon by astronauts between 1969 and 1972 can still be reached by lasers fired from Earth, according to a man named only as Ben, whose words are passed on by a guest named James Fox. Fox quotes him as saying "we can put a laser on some of the things that we left on the surface of the moon." It is told as evidence that the Moon landings left real, checkable traces behind.
